canonical_features.name: robust_scatter
canonical_features.rationale: Robust amplitude of stellar-background variability; preferred over ordinary standard deviation when isolated excursions exist.

canonical_features.name: outlier_fraction
canonical_features.rationale: Robust tail/impulsive-variability measure. Raw excess kurtosis is retained as an audit diagnostic rather than a canonical router feature.

canonical_features.name: acf_lag1
canonical_features.rationale: Short-lag correlation strength of the stellar background.

canonical_features.name: acf_timescale_days
canonical_features.rationale: Persistence timescale of correlated variability; distinct from one-cadence ACF strength.

canonical_features.name: stationarity_state
canonical_features.rationale: Joint interpretation of ADF/KPSS evidence; raw ADF/KPSS statistics and p-values remain supporting diagnostics.

canonical_features.name: spectral_concentration
canonical_features.rationale: Degree to which spectral power is concentrated rather than broadly distributed across frequencies.

canonical_features.name: harmonic_power_ratio
canonical_features.rationale: Strength of harmonically related spectral structure.

canonical_features.name: dominant_period_days
canonical_features.rationale: Final v2 Lomb-Scargle dominant timescale. Legacy dominant_period_days is intentionally lower priority.

canonical_features.name: period_agreement_error
canonical_features.rationale: Harmonic-aware disagreement between LS and ACF timescales; lower values imply stronger independent support for the same periodic structure.

canonical_features.name: segment_scale_variability
canonical_features.rationale: Robust segment-to-segment variability of the local flux scale, capturing amplitude/variance nonstationarity across the quarter without implying a monotonic drift.
